Name: D_0
dialogue: Another day, another dollar. Not that I am making any money.

Name: D_1
dialogue: But that changes today! I refuse to have another day of this boulderdash. I will become employed!

Name: D_2
dialogue: Intelligence, charisma, organization, and athleticism! I am a full-package, hardworking citizen ready to contribute!

Name: D_4
dialogue: Somebody out there is destined to be my employer!

Name: D_5
dialogue: I have been beating myself way too much lately. I need to find some way to relax before tonight. And I will NOT be spending my time standing out in this heat for 5+ hours so some minimum-wage worker can tell me she doesn't have a job for me again.

Name: D_6
dialogue: I should hit up Thran. Maybe they would be down to play a game or two. But first, I need to see if Nyra has something for me.

Name: D_7
dialogue: (Boots up PC) Ah, perfect, you woke up on schedule
